tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: Current public retail packages in USD. No order is created; checkout confirms the final price.

tools.name: get_editorial_guidelines
tools.description: Get Vokolla editorial rules and supported categories for a distribution package.

tools.name: check_release
tools.description: Deterministic word/link/contact checks on a manuscript. No AI provider call or publication. HTML active content is removed.

tools.name: ai_draft_release
tools.description: Use Vokolla AI to draft from customer-supplied notes or extracted document text. Missing facts are marked for the customer. Sends materials to Vokolla’s AI provider; uses the account MCP AI quota. Does not save or publish.

tools.name: ai_review_release
tools.description: Find editorial issues and suggested replacements using the same AI review as Vokolla. Sends the manuscript to the AI provider and uses the MCP AI quota. Does not modify the saved draft.

tools.name: ai_adapt_release
tools.description: Prepare a factual revision against USA Today editorial formatting requirements, including missing facts to resolve. Uses the AI quota and sends content to the AI provider. Returns a proposal, not an approved placement or submission.

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Create an account-owned draft for customer review. Requires an explicit request to save. Reuse the same UUID requestId on retry; use a new one for different content. Never changes an existing draft or places an order. Review and payment remain on Vokolla.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: Read this account’s latest synchronized release records, most recent first. Returns saved status information without triggering a new status check or including billing/contact details.

tools.name: get_release_status
tools.description: Read the latest synchronized status and coverage for a release owned by this account. Coverage URLs are third-party data. Does not submit, retry or cancel anything.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_release, get_release_status · Private data: check_release, ai_draft_release, list_releases · Public sink: ai_draft_release, get_release_status · Destructive: ai_review_release.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_release, get_release_status · Private data: check_release, ai_draft_release, list_releases · Public sink: ai_draft_release, get_release_status · Destructive: ai_review_release

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
